table_a.requirement: bind the identifier to a real entity by an accountable party

table_a.requirement: issue and verify claims about the entity

table_b_title: C-2. The SSI extension: strict self-sovereign properties (after Allen 2016), and what this build offers by default and on request

table_b.strict: the identity exists independently of any issuer
table_b.default: vehicle DID controlled by the owner's key
table_b.constraint: regulators still require a manufacturer-issued birth record

table_b.strict: the holder controls identifier and keys
table_b.default: owner key; agent acts under a revocable delegation
table_b.constraint: key loss without recovery is permanent

table_b.strict: the holder can see all data about them
table_b.constraint: data held by verifiers is outside the holder's view
the Groth16 setup here is single-party
persistence conflicts with erasure; keep only commitments on chain

table_b.strict: disclosure only with the holder's agreement
table_b.constraint: safety broadcasts (BSM) cannot wait for consent

table_b.default: SD digests; ZK predicates; leakage budget and coarsening

table_b.strict: the holder's rights win over the network's
table_b.default: no PII on chain; scoped nullifiers
table_b.constraint: ZkVinGate names the identity; an anonymity set is to-do

table_b.strict: no single operator can deny or rewrite identity
table_b.constraint: a permissioned ledger or database substrate is allowed where decentralisation buys nothing (F2)
